definitions.full: H3214. yelel יְלֵל noun [masculine] howling (of beasts); — יְשִׁמֹ֑ן יְלֵל וּבְתֹהוּ Deut 32:10 in a waste of howling of a desert (= in the howling waste of a desert ; see Dr).
